notes.title: Patch note #5 for Fantastic Haven - version 0.8.10228
notes.content:
Hello all!

Please find below the content of this new patch that fixes some A.I. bugs!

Patch note for Fantastic Haven - version 0.8.10228
Fixes:

 Fixed an A.I. bug that blocked all characters when a building was upgraded and the player was in the region.
 Fixed some cases of characters stuck under the ground when terrain was modified with biotopes.


We are continuously reading all your feedbacks and user reports! Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Patch #4"Performance" - v0.8.10188
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here's a first major update for Fantastic Haven Prologue based on your feedbacks & reports.
We've mainly focused on addressing the performance issues that most of you might have encountered and fix a few gameplay bugs that prevented you to enjoy the full experience of this Prologue in the meantime!
We keep on working on performance and some bugs you're having, but we're also progressing on the development of the game for the future release of the Early Access!
We hope that this patch will help a lot of you to try our game and we would love to get feedbacks from you on this patch!

Thanks for playing Fantastic Haven, and thanks for your support!

Have a fantastic day!

Patch note version 0.8.10188

Optimizations:

 Optimized placing and removing nature props in biotopes
 Terrain optimization
 Textures resolutions optimization
 Environment assets optimization

Fixes

 Fixed victory point about cohabitation between a Pegasus and a Wisp’hart that was sometimes not correctly updating
 Fixed expeditions getting stuck when trying to travel long paths
 Fixed balloon toy getting stuck out of bound
 Fixed golems behaviors issues when catching an aggressive creatur
 Fixed bug that could cause characters to walk through the ground
 Fixed some glitches on LoD of environment assets

notes.title: Patch note for Fantastic Haven - version 0.8.9967
notes.content:
This patch is another one in the series of minor patches we could quickly do to mitigate slightly some performance issues.  We know most of you are waiting patiently for the big performance patch: it's on his way! 

Patch note for Fantastic Haven - version 0.8.9967
Graphics:

 Optimizations on environment assets, better impostors & lods for trees in the distance
 LOD & Impostors ratio tweaking

Fixes:

 Fixed a nasty exception causing strange random behaviours in the game


Thank you again for your patience! We are continuously reading all your feedbacks and user reports! Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Patch note for Fantastic Haven - version 0.8.9920
notes.content:
Patch note for Fantastic Haven - version 0.8.9920

Modifications:

 Some optimisation in low quality settings
 Addition of a “very low” quality setting


Fixes:

 Fixed: previously if a golem dies while bringing food, no other golem will complete the task, so the feeders will always be empty.
 Fixed: previously some creatures couldn’t go to sleep in the medium shelter.


Thank you for your feedbacks!

notes.title: Patch note for Fantastic Haven: version 0.8.9888
notes.content:
Patch note for Fantastic Haven - version 0.8.9888

Fixes:

 Fixed golems that could not catch fleeing creatures if too close to a building.
 Fixed Haven map disappearing sometimes after switching to it from the region map.
 Fixed signing the “reforestation” treaty has no visible action on the region. 

Modifications:

 Increased golem lifespan.
 Modification of the message on level 2 locked buttons in the architecture research tree to make it easier to understand what needs to be done.
